name: RELAY-16
author: David Ryan
description: RELAY-16 is a sequencer with no sound of its own. Sixteen tracks play other instruments over USB, Bluetooth and (on the SMK-37) the TRS jack: another FM-1 running LOOM-8, a hardware synth, or a DAW. Steps hold chords, conditions, chance, ratchets, micro-timing and four CC locks; scenes, a song, mutes and fills run the performance.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). The SMK-37 board layer: M. Geisler (genkigenki) and Kerem Kilic (keremimo). Bluetooth: Optimist's stack by Henri David (MPL-2.0). Fonts: Barlow (SIL OFL 1.1).
